# WinTun - Layer 3 TUN Driver for Windows

Client only. Download from: https://www.wintun.net/

This source tree keeps only `wintun.h`.

For local builds or binary releases, download the official Wintun package and
place the matching `wintun.dll` alongside the built client executable at
runtime.

License: `wintun.h` is marked `GPL-2.0 OR MIT`; VLan uses the MIT option for
the header. Prebuilt Wintun DLLs have license terms supplied in the official
Wintun ZIP package. Include that official notice when redistributing the DLL.
